title: JournalEvent
description: An event envelope as appended to a coordinator JSONL journal.

seq.title: SequenceNumber
seq.description: Journal sequence number, assigned by the single writer; strictly increasing.

event_id.title: EventId
event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier chosen by the producer; the dedupe key at ingest.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

attempt_id.title: AttemptId
attempt_id.description: Identifier of one attempt of a job.

producer_id.title: ProducerId
producer_id.description: Identifier of the process or worker that produced an event.

producer_seq.title: SequenceNumber
producer_seq.description: Per-producer sequence number; with producer_id it orders and dedupes events.

ts.title: Timestamp
ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

type.title: EventType
type.description: Dotted lowercase event type, for example `run.started` or `console.line`.

payload.description: Typed payload for this event type; a JSON object.
